cases.name: harder/cache-dependency-invalidation
cases.note: Frozen luna primary choice and task depth; source report sha256 ef5d8d4ead3884df0e127f38ae2ed82884fda97b2ff88560884b50fdb2f408d3.
cases.prompt: Our TypeScript backend caches permission lookups inside each request. After a group membership changes within a batch, later operations reuse a stale result. Follow the known dependency chain from member to group to effective permissions, fix invalidation in the request-local cache, and test interleaved mutations and reads. No distributed cache, token changes or unknown isolation failure is involved. Planned maintenance.
